description: OS Mastermap Highways Network - Paths is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ordnance Survey. OS MasterMap® Highways Network – Paths is the most accurate and authoritative path network dataset for Great Britain. It reveals who's responsible for all the footpaths through towns and cities. OS MasterMap Highways Network - Paths helps you understand how people connect to towns and cities around them. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ordnance Survey. Its tags are Transport networks, path, road network, road transport, transportation. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
